title: Studio and customer authorization
summary: Members, leads and customers receive explicit authorization. Inheritance reuses permission rules without granting project ownership.

R-CLIENT.title: Customer
R-CLIENT.assignment_rule: Invited by the lead and assigned to a specific customer space.

R-DESIGNER.title: Designer
R-DESIGNER.assignment_rule: Granted project membership by the studio administrator.

R-LEAD.title: Project lead
R-LEAD.assignment_rule: Explicitly assigned as lead for a particular project, never inferred by AI.

R-ADMIN.title: Studio administrator
R-ADMIN.assignment_rule: Authorized by the studio owner to manage membership and connections.

AP-001.title: Submit own feedback
AP-001.applies_when: Only in the customer’s own space.

AP-003.title: Assess delivery impact
AP-003.applies_when: The designer belongs to the current project.

AP-004.title: Commit an additional delivery date
AP-004.applies_when: The member has not been explicitly granted R-LEAD for this project.

AP-005.title: Confirm a scope arrangement
AP-005.applies_when: The lead owns the project and has sufficient evidence.

AP-006.title: Return for more information
AP-006.applies_when: Identify the missing information and retain the request.

AP-007.title: Configure a connection
AP-007.applies_when: The connection belongs to the studio.

AP-008.title: Export decision records
AP-008.applies_when: Restrict the export to the authorized studio and exclude secret values.

RI-LEAD-DESIGNER.title: Lead retains member capabilities
RI-LEAD-DESIGNER.description: Do not extend access to other projects; inherited deny policies still require review.
